text: وسے پوہ، جیہے ایہ تیہے اوہ۔
romanized: Vassé Poh, jehé eh tehé oh.
literal_en: If it rains in Poh, these and those are equal
meaning_en: i.e., both early and late sown crops will come on equally.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
